themes.title: Orbit
themes.tagline: Titanium, starlight and the curve of the Earth.

themes.title: Prism
themes.tagline: Light, glass and colour at rest.

motions.title: First Light
motions.description: An aperture opens into a restrained champagne-metal title. Original synthesized sound.

motions.title: Signal Weave
motions.description: Independent cobalt signal paths cohere into a woven field. Deliberately silent.

motions.title: Weight of Type
motions.description: Oversized typography acquires mass through compression, rhythm and release. Deliberately silent.

motions.title: Passage
motions.description: A titanium X unlatches into deep space as a blue planet rises toward first sunlight.
motions.prompt: A brushed-titanium X seals the frame like a vault door. It unlatches with a soft metallic click, its four arms part, and we fall through into deep space. A blue planet rises from below, city lights glittering on its night side, until the sun crests the limb in a single clean flare and a warm chord resolves. 9 seconds, 1920×1080, original synthesized score.

motions.title: Terminator Line
motions.description: One unbroken glide along the edge of night, cities amber and an aurora breathing.
motions.prompt: Low orbit, slow and silent. We glide along the line where night becomes day. Cities burn amber on the dark side, thin cloud bands catch the first light, and a faint green aurora breathes near the horizon. The camera never cuts; the planet does the moving. End as sunlight reaches the ground below. 10 seconds, 1920×1080, low drone score.

motions.title: Eclipse
motions.description: A dark moon swallows the sun, the corona unfolds, and the diamond ring breaks free.
motions.prompt: Deep black. A thin crescent of sunlight is swallowed as a dark moon slides across the sun. At totality the corona unfolds in fine pearl filaments and the stars come out. A single bead of light breaks free on the far edge: the diamond ring. Then the dark lifts. 10 seconds, 1920×1080, near silence that blooms into one bell tone at the diamond ring.

motions.title: Dispersion
motions.description: A white beam meets a glass prism and fans into a slow, sweeping spectrum.
motions.prompt: A pale studio, paper-white and still. A narrow beam of white light crosses the frame and strikes a triangular glass prism. Inside the glass it bends; leaving it, it fans into a full spectrum that paints the floor in clean bands of colour. The prism turns a few degrees and the rainbow sweeps like a slow hand. 9 seconds, 1920×1080, glassy harmonic score.

motions.title: Caustics
motions.description: Sunlit caustics on a stone pool floor tear apart at one drop and knit back.
motions.prompt: Overhead view of a shallow pool with a pale stone floor. Sunlight through the water draws a living net of caustics. A single drop falls; rings travel outward, the net tears apart and slowly knits back together. Clear, cool, meditative. 10 seconds, 1920×1080, one drop and soft resonant water tones.

motions.title: Lens
motions.description: A glass sphere rolls over a fine grid, bending and flipping it with a rainbow edge.
motions.prompt: A flawless glass sphere rolls slowly across a sheet of fine printed grid lines. Wherever it passes, the grid swells, bends and flips upside down inside the glass, edged with a thin rainbow of chromatic aberration. Precise, minimal, quietly satisfying. 9 seconds, 1920×1080, a soft rolling tone and a tuned chime as it stops.

motions.title: Bloom
motions.description: One drop of ink blooms in warm water, settles into a flower and dissolves.
motions.prompt: A single drop of black ink falls into clear water lit by warm rice-paper light. It blooms into soft tendrils that curl, split and drift like smoke, slowly settling into the shape of a flower before dissolving to grey. 10 seconds, 1920×1080, the sound of the drop and a breathy bamboo-flute tone.

motions.title: Stroke
motions.description: An unseen brush draws an open enso in one breath, then a vermilion seal lands.
motions.prompt: Textured washi paper, warm and empty. An unseen brush draws one continuous enso circle in a single breath: heavy wet ink at the start, dry bristle streaks as it runs out, the circle left deliberately open. A small abstract vermilion seal lands in the corner. 8 seconds, 1920×1080, the hush of a brush and one low gong.

motions.title: Mist
motions.description: A slow drift through receding ink-wash ridges, a crane and one vermilion sun.
motions.prompt: Layers of ink-wash mountains recede into mist, each ridge paler than the last. The camera drifts slowly forward through them as fog rolls between the peaks. A single crane crosses the far sky. Monochrome, with one vermilion sun low in the haze. 12 seconds, 1920×1080, wind and a sparse plucked-string melody.

motions.title: One Orbit
motions.description: A narrated minute: the door opens, the planet rises, a day of sixteen sunrises passes and the moon covers the sun.
motions.prompt: A sixty-second narrated film cut from Passage, Terminator and Eclipse. The seal opens and the camera falls toward the planet, sunrise breaks over the limb, the terminator sweeps through sixteen sunrises in a single day, then the moon covers the sun, and the diamond ring returns the light. Long narration, an original score, sound effects locked to picture, a perfect mix and designed transitions between shots. 1920×1080.
transcript: Every orbit begins with a door.
Open it, and the ground lets go.
Then the world rises to meet you. Blue, and impossibly thin at the edge.
Ninety minutes to circle it. Sixteen sunrises in a single day.
On the night side, cities glow like embers. Every light is someone, still awake.
And once in a long while, the moon steps in front of the sun.
The day goes out, and the sun shows what it hides: its crown.
Then the light comes back. It always does.

motions.title: Bending Light
motions.description: A narrated minute: white light splits in a prism, water gathers it into living lines, and a glass sphere focuses it to a point.
motions.prompt: A sixty-second narrated film cut from Dispersion, Caustics and Lens. A beam strikes a prism and fans into its colours, red bending least and violet most; a refracting sheet of glass carries us to caustics on a pool floor, where one drop breaks the pattern and it knits back; a second pane carries us to a glass sphere rolling to rest and burning the light to a single point. Long narration, an original score of struck glass, sound effects locked to picture, a clean mix and designed transitions between shots. As strong as One Orbit. 1920×1080.
transcript: White light looks simple. It isn't.
Send it through glass, and it comes apart: every colour it was carrying, side by side.
Red bends the least. Violet bends the most.
A surface moves, and light gathers into bright, living lines.
One drop, and the pattern breaks, rings out, and knits itself back together.
Glass can gather light, as well as split it.
A sphere becomes a lens, and the light it gathers burns to a single point.
Even now, the lens in your eye is bending light, to show you this.
